## Problem and resulting behaviour

## Validation

List actual commands and results, including meaningful negative/boundary cases. Mark omissions as not run with reasons. Distinguish deterministic tests from model review.

## Deviations and tradeoffs

Identify the original spec requirement, departure, reason, decision-maker/status, effect on consumers/checks and rollback. Use `none` when applicable; do not hide departures under miscellaneous notes.

- Requested reviewer and unresolved discussion:

Do not claim peer approval, tests, deployment or publication without evidence. All integration follows the configured PR policy.
